findings.title: OptimizedCursorPaginator breaks datetime ordering
findings.body: src/sentry/api/paginator.py OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_item_key/value_from_cursor copy Paginator numeric logic (math.floor/ceil on value, cursor.value as-is) but src/sentry/api/endpoints/organization_auditlogs.py uses it with order_by="-datetime". For datetime fields value is a datetime, so math.floor(datetime) raises TypeError and integer cursor values are compared against a datetime column in build_queryset, producing wrong queries or crashes. It must subclass DateTimePaginator logic, not numeric Paginator logic.

findings.title: Client-controlled negative offset passed to Django queryset slice
findings.body: src/sentry/api/paginator.py OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_result allows start_offset=cursor.offset when cursor.offset<0 and enable_advanced_features is true. cursor.offset comes from the user-supplied cursor string via Cursor.from_string. Django QuerySet slicing does not support negative indexes and raises AssertionError (Negative indexing is not supported), so a crafted cursor like 0:-100:0 causes a 500 instead of a 400 BadPaginationError as OffsetPaginator/ChainPaginator do. The comment claiming Django handles negative slicing automatically is false.

findings.title: BasePaginator silently clamps invalid forward offsets
findings.body: src/sentry/api/paginator.py BasePaginator.get_result changed from queryset[offset:stop] to max(0,offset) for non-prev cursors. Other paginators in the same file explicitly reject offset<0 with BadPaginationError. Silently rewriting a tampered negative cursor to 0 returns the first page instead of an error, hiding invalid cursors and making pagination behavior inconsistent across paginators.

findings.title: Cursor allows negative offsets without validation
findings.body: src/sentry/utils/cursors.py Cursor.__init__/from_string accept any int(offset) including negatives with only a comment change. All existing pagination validation assumed offsets are non-negative (e.g. SequencePaginator asserts offset>-1, OffsetPaginator raises on offset<0). Removing that invariant at the shared primitive enables the negative-slice crashes above and invalid prev/next cursors built by build_cursor.
